description_for_human: Query Shreyans Khunteta's software engineering portfolio — projects, skills, experience, and AI-powered search.
description_for_model: REST API for querying Shreyans Khunteta's portfolio. Use GET /api/portfolio/search?q=<query> for semantic search, GET /api/portfolio/projects for project listings, GET /api/portfolio/skills for skills, GET /api/portfolio/experience for work history, POST /api/portfolio/ask for Q&A, POST /api/portfolio/assess-fit for job fit assessment.
